methodology: Named public green spaces within 250 metres of an active visitor boundary were reviewed and merged using their OSM polygon geometries. Peterborough crematorium was excluded as non-visitor context and the extensive Nene Wetlands polygon was retained as a regional reserve rather than used to define Irthlingborough town.
